scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --pretty false
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.harness: npm run build --workspace @llm-ttrpg/harness --workspace @llm-ttrpg/harness-cli && npm run start --workspace @llm-ttrpg/harness-cli
scripts.replay:live: tsup scripts/live-replay-session.ts --format esm --platform node --out-dir node_modules/.cache/llm-ttrpg-live-replay --clean && node node_modules/.cache/llm-ttrpg-live-replay/live-replay-session.js
